email.label: Amazon e-mail
email.help: Parcel Master signs in to amazon.de with this account and reads the orders of the last 30 days.

password.label: Amazon password
password.help: Stored on your server, unencrypted, like the API keys, and only if the sign-in works.

otp_secret.label: Two-step secret key
otp_secret.help: Only if two-step verification is on: the long key (letters and digits 2–7) Amazon shows when you add an authenticator app ("Can't scan the barcode?"). Not the six-digit code. Without it nobody can type the code for the server.
